meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在回答前自动回忆过去对话中的相关记忆，并在每轮对话后保存新的要点。这些记忆跨会话保留，即使容器重启也不丢失。
howto.when: 当容器使用默认 Claude provider 启动时，会在每次对话前自动调取相关记忆，并在每轮结束后写入新见解；只对 Claude Code 环境生效，其他 provider 不会触发。

say.text: 你还记得我们上个月讨论过的数据库选型吗？
say.note: Claude 会从记忆中检索并回应，无需你重述。

say.text: 记住：客户王总的项目截止日期是下周五。
say.note: 该信息会被存入长期记忆，后续对话可用。

say.text: 基于我们之前聊过的偏好，推荐一个方案。
say.note: Claude 会结合历史记忆给出个性化回答。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically recalls relevant past memory before answering and stores new insights after each turn. Memory persists across sessions and container restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggered on each container start under the default Claude provider, recalling relevant context before responses and saving insights after each turn. Only works in Claude Code environment; other providers won't trigger the hooks.

say_en.text: Do you remember our discussion about database selection last month?
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve from memory and respond without you restating.

say_en.text: Remember: client Mr. Wang's project deadline is next Friday.
say_en.note: This info will be saved to long-term memory for future conversations.

say_en.text: Recommend a solution based on our previous preferences.
say_en.note: Claude will combine historical memory for a personalized answer.
